title: Schedule of Monthly Rider Premiums and Billing Terms
content:
Rates and billing terms for the Optional Supplemental Benefit Riders, effective for the current contract year.

## 1. Rate schedule

| Rider | Monthly rider premium (USD) | Premium due day of the coverage month | Days of grace after the first unpaid premium | Premium carried on the medical plan bill |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgecrest Preventive Dental Rider | 12.40 | 5 | 60 | yes |
| Ridgecrest Vision Plus Rider | 9.80 | 5 | 60 | yes |
| Ridgecrest Hearing Advantage Rider | 16.30 | 5 | 60 | yes |
| Ridgecrest Comprehensive Dental Rider | 28.60 | 5 | 60 | yes |
| Ridgecrest Premier Dental Rider | 46.90 | 1 | 90 | yes |
| Ridgecrest Dental Vision Hearing Bundle Rider | 61.50 | 1 | 90 | yes |

## 2. What each column states

2.1 The monthly rider premium is the premium charged for the rider for each coverage month, in USD.

2.2 The premium due day is the calendar day of the coverage month on which the rider premium falls due.

2.3 The days of grace are the calendar days allowed after the first unpaid rider premium before the rider is suspended.

2.4 The final column states whether the rider premium appears on the medical plan bill rather than on a bill of its own. On every rider in this schedule it does.

## 3. Notes on the schedule

3.1 The two rates carrying a due day of the first of the coverage month are the Ridgecrest Premier Dental Rider and the Ridgecrest Dental Vision Hearing Bundle Rider; the remaining four fall due on the fifth.

3.2 The same two riders are the only ones allowing 90 days of grace; the other four allow 60.

3.3 Between the lowest and the highest rate in the schedule — 9.80 USD on the Ridgecrest Vision Plus Rider and 61.50 USD on the Ridgecrest Dental Vision Hearing Bundle Rider — the rate rises with the breadth of what the rider covers.
